evidence: Recorded Hamburg port radar and pseudonymous AIS. Not live.
attribution: HAXR by Nis Meinert and Lucas Moreira, German Aerospace Center (DLR).
sourceVerification: All four byte lengths and published MD5 checksums matched the Zenodo API metadata. SHA-256 recorded on downloaded bytes.

raivari.reuse: Original extractor, parseHaxr, selectHaxrAis, haxrPixels, pairRadarFrames and compareStationContinuity; no substitute pairing, AIS selection or common-clock continuity algorithm.

transformation.raster: 128 x 128 Cartesian cell-centre bins over +/-2000 m; maximum amplitude per bin; 31.25 m bin width.
transformation.display: Fixed logarithmic normalization over all 16 frames separately for each station. Missing bins transparent; measured zero remains opaque.
transformation.timing: Radar acquisition intervals retained. Extract includes timing investigation metadata; the browser core displays validated frame boundaries, not per-cell acquisition instants.
transformation.ais: Latest report per pseudonymous ID at/before each frame end, at most 10 s old. Conflicting latest timestamps excluded. No interpolation or prediction.
transformation.pairing: Existing offline left-anchored greedy pairing by maximum start/end difference, one use per counterpart. User can switch anchor and vary endpoint tolerance from 0 to 3 s.
transformation.selectedHistory: Full-window history for one pseudonymous AIS ID. Native AIS selection is evaluated at each station's radar-frame end; newer, held, stale, conflicting and unseen states remain distinct. Displayed breadcrumbs contain only prior non-conflicting reports at/before that station's displayed frame end, including the extraction lookback. No interpolated path or radar object track.
transformation.continuity: Original compareStationContinuity sampled at five-second intervals on the common recording window, filtered to the selected UID. A final partial interval is omitted. This is availability of copies of one shared AIS source, not an independent witness count or a radar handoff.
transformation.localReturns: Station-local circular inspection around native eligible frame-end AIS only; bin centres within 62.5, 125 or 250 m. Counts positive maximum-amplitude bins above a user-selected floor on the existing fixed per-station logarithmic display scale. Missing and zero bins stay distinct. Nearest qualifying bin is not a detected target. No per-bin time, motion compensation, calibrated geometry or vessel association is inferred.

limits: Station AIS files are projections of one shared upstream stream, not independent witnesses.
Local coordinate frames are not spatially aligned; no geometric fusion, radar detection or target association.
Pseudonymous IDs do not establish MMSI, IMO, hull or sanctioned status.
Tolerance is an experimental eligibility bound, not calibrated clock uncertainty.
Acquisition intervals contain cells observed at different times; this is not a snapshot at one instant.
UTC seconds since midnight are retained; no calendar date inferred.
Brightness is not calibrated power or comparable equal strength between stations.
Published hashes are unsigned integrity references, not authentication.
No relationship is asserted between these recordings, the live transport journal or the fictional identity ledger.
